ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Funding Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the handling of Medicaid funding in Minnesota and potentially other states, following the money to uncover any patterns of fraud or abuse.
questions: What is the scope of the Medicaid funding investigation in Minnesota?
Are there any other states or entities involved in the investigation?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover a significant pattern of fraud and abuse in Medicaid funding, and that following the money will be key to uncovering the truth.
